decisions.title: Use MongoDB for ProductCatalogService
decisions.summary: Store products as documents in MongoDB for schema flexibility and BASE consistency.

decisions.title: Keep OrderService on SQL Server
decisions.summary: Orders require ACID consistency for financial records.

decisions.title: Use SQL Server for InventoryService
decisions.summary: Inventory requires ACID consistency to manage stock accurately.

decisions.title: Use Redis for Cache in Phase 4
decisions.summary: Implement Redis cache-aside for catalog reads.

decisions.title: Strangler Fig Migration Strategy
decisions.summary: Peel off one service at a time to migrate from monolith to microservices.

decisions.title: One Project per Service
decisions.summary: Each service is its own .NET 8 project with layered folders for deployability.

decisions.title: Database-per-Service Rule
decisions.summary: Each service owns its data and does not access other services' databases.

decisions.title: Synchronous HTTP Communication in Phase 2
decisions.summary: Services communicate via synchronous HTTP calls for simplicity.

decisions.title: Use Ocelot for API Gateway
decisions.summary: Implement Ocelot as the single public entry point for routing.

decisions.title: BFF Aggregation
decisions.summary: BFF aggregates order and catalog data into one response.

decisions.title: Load Balancing with nginx
decisions.summary: Use nginx to load balance requests across catalog replicas.

decisions.title: Asynchronous Messaging with RabbitMQ
decisions.summary: Replace synchronous flow with RabbitMQ for asynchronous messaging.

decisions.title: Choreography Order Saga
decisions.summary: Implement a choreography saga for order processing with compensation.

decisions.title: Redis Cache-Aside
decisions.summary: Implement Redis cache-aside for catalog reads with invalidation on updates.

decisions.title: Structured Logging with Serilog
decisions.summary: Use Serilog for structured logging in every service, aggregated in Seq.

decisions.title: Health Checks and Docker Compose
decisions.summary: Implement health checks in each service and use Docker Compose for orchestration.

decisions.title: Correlation ID Propagation
decisions.summary: Propagate X-Correlation-ID across services and RabbitMQ for distributed tracing.

rules.rule: Each service owns its data and does not access other services' databases.
Services communicate via synchronous HTTP calls in Phase 2.
Use Ocelot as the API Gateway for routing.
BFF aggregates order and catalog data into one response.
Use nginx for load balancing across catalog replicas.
Replace synchronous flow with asynchronous messaging using RabbitMQ.
Implement a choreography saga for order processing with compensation.
Use Redis cache-aside for catalog reads with invalidation on updates.
Use Serilog for structured logging in every service, aggregated in Seq.
Implement health checks in each service and use Docker Compose for orchestration.
Propagate X-Correlation-ID across services and RabbitMQ for distributed tracing.
